titulo: Middle East crisis live: Trump claims Gaza deal reached; Iran targets US bases in Kuwait
cuerpo: Response from Hamas and Israeli officials suggest Gaza deal still faces obstacles; Tehran launches drone strikes at Kuwait in retaliation for recent US attacks Trump claims agreement for ‘complete disarmament’ of Hamas in Gaza but support uncertain Saudi Arabia prepares sea and possible land offensive against Houthis Meanwhile, in Lebanon , local media reported “massive explosions” overnight in the southern parts of the country, where Israeli forces say they have blasted an underground tunnel network belonging to Hezbollah. Lebanon’s official National News Agency (NNA) reported explosions in Yahmar al-Shaqif, Arnoun and Kfar Tebnit, all areas close to the Beaufort Ridge that is occupied by the Israeli military.
